title: 第12章：出发前的准备
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“我说滚——”

    “带着你家的兔崽子，从我家滚出去，我家不欢迎你们！”

    马超声音冷硬，眼底寒意彻骨，半分情面不留。

    话落，院门口瞬间针落可闻，气氛骤然僵死。

    “你！你！你——”

    江彩霞一张脸瞬间涨成了猪肝色，指着马超的手不停的哆嗦着。

    她活这么大，从来都是她欺负别人，什么时候像今天一样，被人指着鼻子骂滚。

    “啊！老娘要撕烂你这张嘴！”

    “住手！我看谁敢欺负我哥！”

    哒哒哒——

    骤然传来一阵急促的脚步声。

    三道小小的身影冲了出来，手里是扫帚和擀面杖，像极了三只炸了毛的刺猬。

    马娟快步挡在马超前面，将扫帚对准江彩霞的脸，“出去，我们家不欢迎你们！”

    “走，不然打到了可别怪我。”

    “小丫头片子，反了天了，你还敢打我。”

    “有啥不敢的！”

    马强眼神凶狠，挥舞着擀面杖踏出一步，吓得母子两人连退两步。

    “你们这帮小兔崽子疯了不成。”

    田虎色厉内荏的吼道，“马强，你敢打我，我回去就告诉我爸，让揍死你。”

    “来啊，怕你！”

    “你们都是坏银，不准欺负蝈蝈。”

    奶声奶气的声音响起，谁能想到，两岁的小团子挡在三人前面，那表情，那眼神，跟要吃人似的。

    三个小家伙明明年纪都不大，此刻却一副誓死要保护大哥，保护家的模样，让马超感到好笑的同时，心里却是一暖。

    “你们几个跑出来干啥，都回屋里去，这里有大哥呢。”

    “我不，大哥，我们不走！我们保护你！”

    “对！不走！”

    “打坏银！”莉莉捏紧了小拳头。

    “妈！我们回去吧。”

    田虎退到江彩霞身后，江彩霞也被这四双狼崽子一样的眼神给震慑住了，语气不由弱了几分，“马超……小超，娟子，强子，这是干啥，不就是几块肉嘛，我可是你们长辈。”

    “屁的长辈！”

    “我们家才没有你这么没脸没皮的长辈，吃不起肉，跑来我家打秋风，真不要脸。”

    “赶紧走！不然我喊人了。”

    江彩霞脸色铁青，见马超油盐不进，她干脆也不装了。

    “行！你厉害！”
content_en:
"I said get out-"

    "Take your little bastard and get out of my house. You are not welcome in my house!"

    Ma Chao's voice was cold and hard, his eyes were bone-chilling, and he showed no emotion at all.

    As soon as the words fell, a needle could be heard at the door of the courtyard, and the atmosphere suddenly became stiff.

    "You! You! You-"

    Jiang Caixia's face instantly turned the color of pig liver, and her hand pointing at Ma Chao kept trembling.

    She has always been the one to bully others in her whole life. How could she be pointed in the nose and scolded like today?

    "Ah! I'm going to tear your mouth apart!"

    "Stop! Let's see who dares to bully my brother!"

    Da da da——

    Suddenly there was a rush of footsteps.

    Three small figures rushed out, holding brooms and rolling pins in their hands, resembling three hairless hedgehogs.

    Ma Juan quickly stood in front of Ma Chao and pointed the broom at Jiang Caixia's face, "Get out, you are not welcome in our home!"

    "Go, otherwise don't blame me if you get hit."

    "Little girl, you've gone too far. How dare you hit me?"

    "What's wrong with that?"

    Ma Qiang's eyes were fierce and he took a step forward while waving his rolling pin. The mother and son were so frightened that they took two steps back.

    "You little bastards are crazy."

    Tian Hu shouted with an expression of anger, "Ma Qiang, if you dare to hit me, I will tell my dad when I get back and he will beat you to death."

    "Come on, I'm afraid of you!"

    "You are all bad guys, don't bully Grasshopper."

    The sound of milking milk could be heard. Who would have thought that the two-year-old little dumpling was standing in front of the three of them, with an expression and eyes that looked like he was trying to eat someone.

    The three little guys were obviously not very young, but at this moment they looked like they were determined to protect their elder brother and the family. Ma Chao felt funny at the same time, but felt warm in his heart.

    "What are you doing out here? Go back inside. Brother is here."

    "No, brother, we won't leave! We will protect you!"

    "Yes! Don't leave!"

    "Break the silver!" Lily clenched her little fists.

    "Mom! Let's go back."

    Tian Hu retreated behind Jiang Caixia. Jiang Caixia was also shocked by the four pairs of wolf-cub-like eyes, and her tone couldn't help but weaken a little, "Ma Chao... Xiaochao... Xiaochao, Juanzi, Qiangzi, what are you doing? Isn't it just a few pieces of meat? I am your elder."

    "Fucking elder!"

    "We don't have a shameless elder like you in our family. He can't afford meat and comes to my house to beat the autumn wind. It's really shameless."

    "Leave quickly! Otherwise I'll call someone."

    Jiang Caixia's face was livid. Seeing that Ma Chao was out of touch, she simply stopped pretending.

    "Okay! You are awesome!"
